nodes.label: Weighted recent-trend algorithm
nodes.rationale: Weights the last 3 months more heavily (3x/2x/1.5x/1x by recency) so a recent raise or spending change moves the ETA estimate faster than a flat average would.

nodes.label: Non-destructive raise/edit flow for recurring income
nodes.rationale: Editing a recurring income entry's amount closes the old entry (endDate + isActive:false) and creates a new one from the effective date, so historical totals stay accurate instead of being overwritten.
nodes.norm_label: non-destructive raise/edit flow for recurring income

nodes.label: Expense category three-place sync requirement
nodes.rationale: Category enums live in three places that must stay in sync: backend ExpenseEntry.js (EXPENSE_CATEGORIES), frontend types.ts (ExpenseCategory), format.ts (CATEGORY_COLORS), and a category.<name> key in each i18n dictionary — otherwise a new category shows missing color/label/translation.

nodes.label: Static/approximate currency conversion table
nodes.rationale: lib/currency.ts holds a static/approximate conversion table (not live FX rates, clearly commented) used only for display formatting and converting typed amounts back to USD; expected to drift from real rates over time.

nodes.label: Backend suggestion sentences not translated (known limitation)
nodes.rationale: suggestions.js generates plain-language sentences in English only; translating them would require backend-side i18n, which is out of scope for now.
nodes.norm_label: backend suggestion sentences not translated (known limitation)

nodes.label: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL baked in at build time
nodes.rationale: Next.js inlines NEXT_PUBLIC_* vars at build time, not runtime, so changing .env.local requires restarting next dev or rebuilding the Docker image to take effect.
nodes.norm_label: next_public_api_url baked in at build time

nodes.label: MongoDB stays on Atlas, never containerized
nodes.rationale: Both local and Docker runs connect to the same Atlas cluster via MONGODB_URI instead of running a containerized Mongo instance.
nodes.norm_label: mongodb stays on atlas, never containerized

nodes.label: Incremental git history convention
nodes.rationale: One commit per completed feature/step by design, so git log reflects build order: backend scaffold -> stats -> goals/projections -> dashboard -> transactions -> goals UI -> Docker -> shadcn/ui + theme -> i18n -> multi-currency -> Jalali date picker -> shadcn charts.
